title: In situ transplantation of adipose stem cells into mouse epididymal white adipose tissue
author: Liao, Zeng, et al.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and equipment
steps.instruction: Place Matrigel at 4 °C for 12–16 h, chill syringe tips and syringes at –20 °C for ≥30 min and keep all on ice; sterilize all surgical instruments by autoclave; install the isoflurane anesthesia system (machine, gas filter, air pump, chamber, operating table), add 100 % isoflurane solution to the machine and set the system parameters as described in the materials list.

steps.title: Prepare experimental mice
steps.instruction: Use male C57BL/6J mice: (a) 6‑week‑old mice fed a 60 % kcal high‑fat diet (Research Diets Inc., D12492) for 12 weeks, reaching 38–42 g, for ASC isolation; (b) 10‑week‑old mice fed standard chow, weighing 22–25 g, for ASC injection.

steps.title: Isolate SVF from epididymal fat
steps.instruction: Sterilize fine scissors and ophthalmic forceps, prepare 15 mL tubes, 75 % ethanol, 100‑µm cell strainer and DMEM; make collagenase II buffer (1 mg mL⁻¹ collagenase in DMEM) and warm to 37 °C; euthanize mouse by cervical dislocation, immerse in 75 % ethanol for 5 min, place on a sterile laminar flow hood, make a 1 cm longitudinal incision in the lower‑mid abdomen, lift and excise the epididymal fat pad (≈1.5–2.0 g), cut into ~1 cm³ pieces on ice; transfer tissue to collagenase II buffer (5 mL per 1 g tissue) and incubate 30 min at 37 °C with shaking at 120 rpm; filter through a 100‑µm strainer into a 15 mL tube, centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant and resuspend the stromal vascular fraction pellet in 10 mL DMEM/F12 containing 10 % FBS, 1 % Pen/Strep and 10 ng mL⁻¹ b‑FGF.

steps.title: Culture and expand ASCs
steps.instruction: Plate the SVF suspension in DMEM/F12 with 10 % FBS, 1 % Pen/Strep and 10 ng mL⁻¹ b‑FGF; maintain at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, changing medium as needed; passage cells when they reach ≈90 % confluence; continue culture until the third passage, at which point cells are identified as ASCs (yield ≈8–10 × 10⁶ ASCs per mouse).

steps.title: Label ASCs with CellTracker
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm DMEM containing 1 µM CellTracker Deep Red in a 37 °C water bath for 10 min; when third‑passage ASCs are ≈90 % confluent, discard medium and wash cells three times with PBS; incubate cells in 5 mL DMEM + 1 µM CellTracker at 37 °C for 30 min (volume adjusted to dish size, e.g., 10‑cm dish); wash cells three times with PBS; digest cells with 0.5 mL TrypLE Express for 1 min at 37 °C, then stop digestion by adding 5 mL DMEM/F12 with 10 % FBS.

steps.title: Resuspend ASCs in Matrigel for injection
steps.instruction: Mix DMEM and Matrigel at a 7:1 ratio on ice; count cells and centrifuge the suspension at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; gently resuspend the pellet in the pre‑chilled DMEM‑Matrigel mixture, using 1 × 10⁶ cells per 100 µL of mixture; avoid foam formation during resuspension.
